title: The Quest
description: A massive RPG-inspired exploration modpack built around discovery, immersion, and adventure.
body:
![THE QUEST by PR1XV3E](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/878cb28dbd1f1f3593b56b88190173af8a49ca0e.png)

A massive RPG-inspired exploration modpack built around discovery, immersion, and adventure.

Travel through sprawling continents filled with hundreds of unique biomes, ancient ruins, forgotten dungeons, dangerous creatures, and hidden treasures. Every journey matters, whether you're charting unknown lands, mastering powerful magic, forging legendary equipment, or uncovering secrets buried beneath the world.

## ✨ Features

### 🗺️ Explore a Living World
- Massive biome expansion with Terralith, Biomes O' Plenty, Regions Unexplored, and Oh The Biomes We've Gone
- Dynamic forests powered by Dynamic Trees
- Improved caves, structures, dungeons, villages, temples, and strongholds
- Hand-crafted exploration progression with maps, journals, relics, and discoveries

### ⚔️ RPG Progression
- Powerful weapons, armor, artifacts, and loot
- Tetra-based modular weapon crafting
- Ars Nouveau magic system
- Bounties, quests, advancements, and progression rewards
- Increasing player power through exploration and experience

### 🐉 Creatures & Bosses
- Dozens of new animals, monsters, and fantasy creatures
- Unique encounters from Alex's Mobs, Enderman Overhaul, Creeper Overhaul, Luminous Beasts, and more
- Challenging bosses and endgame encounters
- Enhanced End progression with End Remastered

### 🌦️ Immersive Survival
- Dynamic weather systems
- Seasonal changes
- Realistic environmental effects
- Improved sounds, particles, water, snow, rain, and atmosphere
- Enhanced sleeping and survival mechanics

### 🏰 Endless Adventure
- Hundreds of structures to discover
- Better dungeons, mineshafts, monuments, caves, bridges, fortresses, and temples
- Loot-focused exploration
- Shared loot systems for multiplayer

### 🎨 Visual & Audio Enhancements
- Better clouds
- Dynamic lighting
- Shaders support via Oculus
- Enhanced particles and weather effects
- Ambient environmental sounds
- Improved UI, HUD, and immersion systems

### 🚀 Optimized for Large Worlds
- Includes performance improvements and memory optimizations
- Designed for long-term survival worlds
- Multiplayer friendly
- Automatic mod synchronization support

---

## 📖 The Goal

This modpack transforms Minecraft into a fantasy adventure sandbox where exploration is the main progression system.

Every mountain may hide a dungeon.

Every forest may contain a forgotten ruin.

Every journey can lead to something legendary.

Pack your supplies, open your atlas, and begin your adventure.
